title: AMLC witness: Romualdez's cash inflows not traced to DPWH, Zaldy Co

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A financial investigator from the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) has observed that no cash inflows of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez were traceable to the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), former lawmaker Zaldy Co, and contractors from June 2022 to September 2025. Atty. Jan Mark Busa made this known as he testified as a witness in the bail hearing of Romualdez before the Sandiganbayan Third Division. This is in connection with his P7.44 billion plunder case over allegations that he received kickbacks from funding for government infrastructure projects in the 2022 to 2025 national budgets.
